info.name: Ampersand public API Key Revision API

params.name: projectIdOrName
params.description: The Ampersand project ID or project name.

params.name: destructive
params.description: Defaults to false. This flag controls whether to perform destructive actions when deploying integrations, like pausing all read actions for an object that was removed in the latest revision.

items.docs: We recommend using the [CLI's deploy command](https://docs.withampersand.com/cli/overview#deploy-integrations) rather than this API endpoint directly, unless you have an advanced use case.

params.name: projectIdOrName
params.description: The Ampersand project ID or project name.

params.name: revisionId
params.description: The revision ID. You can find this on the integration object's `latestRevision.id` field.

params.name: connectionId
params.description: The ID of the consumer's connection to the SaaS provider. This connection's credentials are used to fetch field metadata from the provider's API.

items.docs: Returns the integration revision enriched with live field metadata from the consumer's connected SaaS instance, such as available fields, display names, and type for each object defined in the integration.
